Ivy (product): Heads up: were releasing v3.5.0-private: Delegated Admins (beta) for Private/VPC customers today. Features: scoped admin roles, emergency host-fallback, and signed local audit bundles. Opt-in only.

Ivy (product): Compliance highlights: signed bundles + per-session metadata make offline audit easier. Recommend KMS-backed keys for high-compliance customers.

DeployBot: Rollout started: v3.5.0-private-delegated-admins -> canary us-east-2 at 3671234400

Ben (eng): Implementation note: roles map to SSO or short-lived certs. We emit metrics for auth failures, fallback counts, and bundle generation time.

Rina (security): For SOC2/ISO customers, enable attestations and 60-90 day rotation on operator keys. We'll attach a sample evidence checklist to the KB.

Marta (docs): I'll create the KB + migration checklist. Any quick CLI snippets?

Ivy (product): Use these:
```
# dry-run mapping
redwoodctl access map-roles --mode delegated --dry-run

# enable delegated admins with 48h emergency window
redwoodctl policies set --delegated-admins on --emergency-window 48h --signed-bundles true
```

Ben (eng): Fallback behavior: automatic switch to host emergency operator for configured window; all fallbacks recorded in bundles and trigger Console alerts.

Sam (sales): Sales ask: short customer blurb?

Ivy (product): Blurb: "Delegated Admins let you give teams scoped admin rights with full local auditability, SSO integration, and an opt-in migration path."

DeployBot: Canary complete at 3671234680, monitoring 2h for regressions.

Ben (eng): I'll run staging migration tomorrow and post results.

Marta (docs): Draft KB created, will ping for review.

Rina (security): Added KMS/HSM guidance to notes.

Ivy (product): Action items: Ivy publish announcement + compliance blurb; Ben run staging + runbook; Marta KB; Rina KMS guidance; Sam pilot outreach. Please thumbsup when done.
